deadline.value: International applicants' Fall deadline is April 15; the domestic Fall deadline is June 1.

gre_subject.value: No Computer Science subject test is mentioned.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required, and the page sets no cutoff for considering an application.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores (there is no cutoff for considering the application)

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to review faculty work and contact faculty about open positions.
supervisor.quote: Interested applicants are encouraged to review individual faculty members' publications and contact faculty directly to inquire about availability of open positions.

funding.value: PhD students awarded a graduate assistantship receive a 100% tuition waiver and a stipend.
funding.quote: Full-time PhD students who are awarded a Graduate Assistantship receive a 100% tuition waiver and a stipend.

entry_route.value: Students may enter the PhD directly with a bachelor's or a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Students may be admitted directly to the PhD program with either a bachelor's or a master's degree

ielts_min.value: The department states an IELTS score of 6.5 for applicants whose native language is not English.
ielts_min.quote: For applicants whose native language is not English, a minimum TOEFL score of 550 (paper-based) or 79 (internet-based), or an IELTS score of 6.5

toefl_min.value: The department states TOEFL 79 (internet-based), an old-scale value; it is unconfirmed here, so not saved as a number.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum TOEFL score of 550 (paper-based) or 79 (internet-based)

notes: Deadlines table on the department page: domestic Fall June 1, international Fall April 15. Undergraduate background must include specified CS courses.
